name: Chat Sticker Pack
summary: A set of 8 to 40 drawn characters with a pose, a big face and one short word, sent in a chat as a picture. The LINE messenger made the form common in Asia from 2011.

philosophy.core_thesis: A character with a big face says what a sentence cannot: the chat gets a mascot with a voice.
design_principles: Draw one character in a set of 8, 16, 24 or 40 poses on a square of 370px by 320px or less.
Outline each pose with a 6px to 8px white border, and add a 3px dark line around the figure.
Give the character a head of 50% of the body height, two dot eyes and a mouth of 1 to 3 strokes.
Add one short word of 1 to 3 words in rounded type, with a 4px white outline, in a corner of the sticker.
Fill shapes with flat colour from a palette of 5 to 7 hues and keep shading to one tone.
Tilt the figure by 2° to 4° and let hands and a speech tail break the square edge.
Show the pack as a 4 by 2 grid of 96px thumbnails on a pale green field.
anti_patterns: Thin lines of 1px that vanish at 96px
Background boxes that hide the cut-out edge
Characters with no emotion in the face
Mixed illustration styles in one set

layout.grid_mechanics: A pack grid of 4 columns with 8px gutters; one sticker fills a 96px cell in the list and 240px in the chat.
layout.whitespace_ratio: 20% to 30% of the surface stays empty; the spacing scale is 4, 8, 16 and 24px.
layout.alignment_rules: Stickers sit on the chat side of the sender; the word sits in a corner, tilted by 2° to 4°.
layout.container_geometry: Cards with a 20px radius and a 3px dark line; a sticker has a 6px white cut-out border and no box.

font_pairings.note: A round, heavy display face for the sticker word, with a Japanese-ready text face.
A pop display face for a sweeter pack.

hierarchy_rules: Set the sticker word at 28px to 40px with a 4px outline.
Set the pack name at 20px in 700 weight and the artist at 12px.
Keep body text at 16px with a line height of 1.5.

color.palette_structure: A pale green ground with a strong green and orange, and a dark line colour that outlines each figure.
color.contrast_rules: Line ink on mint holds 14:1; green and orange fill buttons and shapes with dark text on them.
color.surface_treatment: Flat colour fields with a 3px dark line; no gradient and no texture.
color.light_and_shadow: No light direction; a hard 4px drop shadow in line ink under cards.

materiality.surface_simulation: A die-cut paper sticker with a white edge.
materiality.border_rules: A 3px dark line on cards and a 6px white cut-out edge on stickers.
materiality.blur_and_elevation: No blur; a hard 4px offset shadow.

ornamentation_details.iconography: Rounded solid glyphs at 24px in a filled circle of 40px.
ornamentation_details.illustration: A mascot character in 8 to 40 poses with sweat drops, hearts and motion marks.

motion.transition_physics: A sticker drops in with a scale from 0.6 to 1.0 in 250ms; animated packs loop 8 to 24 frames at 12 fps.
motion.hover_and_active: Hover tilts the sticker by 4°; active presses it down by 4px.

emotion.target_response: The viewer feels cute, cheerful and close to a friend.

use_cases: messenger sticker sets and brand mascots
merch and social posts with a mascot
avoid_when: The brand needs a quiet, adult tone.
The channel cannot show transparent images.
The set has no single character to carry it.

modifiers.how: Replace the flat figure with a rendered head with soft light that follows the face.
Use a small round glyph of 1.2em and drop the word and the outline.
Use a loop of 12 to 24 frames and set the word in white capitals with a 2px black outline.

pack.why: A chunky, cartoon family matches the heavy outline of a sticker.

ground.why: A sticker pack is a sheet of small shapes, so the ground scatters confetti behind the grid.
